rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something noticeably bigger than usual, whether or not the speaker is criticizing it.

example.english: This suitcase is oversize and will not fit in the trunk.
example.traditional: 呢個行李箱超大，放唔入架車尾。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hang4 lei5 soeng1 ciu1 daai6 fong3 m4 jap6 gaa3 ce1 mei5

rows.note: Use this for clothing, uniforms, and other products described by size categories, especially when they are made in a large or oversized size.

example.english: I need an oversize uniform for work.
example.jyutping: ngo5 faan1 gung1 jiu3 zoek6 daai6 maa5 zai3 fuk6

rows.note: Use this when the size is excessive or causes a problem, rather than merely being larger than normal.

example.english: The table is oversize and will not fit in the room.
example.jyutping: zoeng1 ci4 taai3 daai6 gaan1 fong4 baai2 m4 lok6
